metrics.cold_warm: Native commands built on fresh runners with no compiler cache step; no warm-cache result established
metrics.comparability: same source-commit naturally repeated runs are observational controls; distinct commits require audited relevant-input, test inventory, command, compiler/platform and parameter equivalence; no before/after claim is made here
metrics.coverage: workflow success can include conditional skipped jobs; executed inventory and each skip are reported explicitly
metrics.elapsed: run.created_at to latest actually executed job.completed_at; workflow metadata updated_at is retained but not treated as execution completion
metrics.queue: first-job start delay is observed; per-job delay includes dependencies/matrix concurrency and must not be labelled queue-only without a dependency model
metrics.runner_minutes: sum(max(0, completed_at-started_at)) over all executed jobs, including failed/cancelled jobs; skipped pseudo-jobs count0; not billable platform multipliers
metrics.zero_jobs: runs with zero jobs have no measured execution interval; created-to-updated latency is not execution time
